title.zh-TW: 金融時報：輝達要求夥伴暫停對東南亞四國出貨伺服器
title.en: FT: Nvidia tells partners to pause server shipments to four Southeast Asian nations

summary.zh-TW: 金融時報引述三位知情人士報導，輝達要求製造夥伴停止向馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國、印尼買家出貨伺服器，戴爾與美超微為首波，是否暫時性不明，輝達未證實。此舉與美國商務部上週新規相關：雲端業者須在90天內取得許可並證明終端用戶非受限實體。輝達2025年經新加坡子公司認列營收約1,040億美元、年增72%。
summary.en: Citing three sources, the FT said Nvidia told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to buyers in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia; duration is unclear and Nvidia has not confirmed. It follows a new US rule giving cloud providers 90 days to get licenses and vet end users. Nvidia booked about US$104B of 2025 revenue via its Singapore unit, up 72%.

impact.zh-TW: 管制從晶片延伸至伺服器與雲端算力，東南亞資料中心專案可能延遲；經濟日報點名緯創等台廠恐出現訂單轉移效應。屬未證實報導與市場推論。
impact.en: Controls appear to be widening from chips to servers and cloud compute, which could delay Southeast Asian data-center projects; UDN flags possible order shifts for Taiwan suppliers such as Wistron. Unconfirmed report and market inference.

title.zh-TW: 美FCC批准SpaceX部署百萬顆衛星，建構太空AI資料中心
title.en: US FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites for space data centers

summary.zh-TW: 美國聯邦通訊委員會宣布授權SpaceX部署最多100萬顆衛星的星座，用於太空資料中心以支援AI算力。執照要求2033年11月前開始部署、2035年11月前完成10%（10萬顆）、2038年11月前完成50%。目前全球在軌衛星約1.7萬顆，報導指SpaceX是否真會發射如此數量仍不明。台股低軌衛星族群26日早盤多檔漲停。
summary.en: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites for space data centers to support AI compute. Deployment must begin by November 2033, with 10% (100,000) by November 2035 and 50% by November 2038. About 17,000 satellites are in orbit today, and reports note it is unclear SpaceX will launch that many. Taiwan LEO supply-chain stocks hit limit-up on Nov. 26 morning.

impact.zh-TW: 屬長期執照而非已實現部署，時程長達十餘年；法人點名啟碁、華通、同欣電等低軌衛星供應鏈，短線題材熱度高，實際訂單仍待驗證。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: This is a long-dated license, not realized deployment, spanning over a decade. Analysts cite Taiwan LEO suppliers such as WNC, Compeq and Tong Hsing; short-term enthusiasm is high but actual orders remain unproven. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 標普將輝達AA評等列入負向觀察，穆迪維持Aa1
title.en: S&P places Nvidia's AA rating on negative watch; Moody's affirms Aa1

summary.zh-TW: 標普全球評級將輝達AA信評列入負向信用觀察，啟動90天評估，理由是執行長黃仁勳去職後又回任所引發的治理與管理疑慮，表示若調降可能僅限一級。穆迪維持Aa1、展望穩定，但指治理與監管不確定性仍在。報導指輝達五年期CDS利差盤中擴大至約147個基點，創新高；股價自10月6日以來跌約38%。
summary.en: S&P put Nvidia's AA rating on negative watch for a 90-day review, citing governance concerns after CEO Jensen Huang's exit and return, and said any cut would likely be one notch. Moody's affirmed Aa1 with a stable outlook but flagged governance and regulatory uncertainty. Reports said Nvidia's 5-year CDS spread widened intraday to about 147bp, a record; shares are down about 38% since Oct. 6.

impact.zh-TW: 信評觀察本身不影響營運，但凸顯AI龍頭治理風險，可能加劇AI供應鏈評價波動；輝達為台積電等台廠重要客戶，台股權值股恐受情緒牽動。以上為推論。
impact.en: A ratings watch does not change operations, but it highlights governance risk at the AI leader and may add to valuation swings across the AI supply chain; as a key customer of TSMC and others, Nvidia sentiment may sway Taiwan heavyweights. Inference.

title.zh-TW: 聯準會褐皮書：美經濟溫和成長，通膨仍居高不下
title.en: Fed Beige Book: US economy grows modestly as inflation stays elevated

summary.zh-TW: 聯準會褐皮書顯示，12個轄區中8個呈輕微至溫和成長、4個持平；消費支出持平、家庭轉向較便宜商品，AI帶動的企業投資維持強勁。投入成本漲幅高於售價，壓縮利潤；克里夫蘭聯準銀行指資料中心需求使晶片與電力設備供應吃緊。資料蒐集至11月16日。期貨顯示市場預期12月8至9日會議再升息。
summary.en: The Fed's Beige Book showed 8 of 12 districts with slight to moderate growth and 4 flat. Spending was flat as households traded down; AI-driven investment stayed strong. Input costs rose faster than selling prices, squeezing margins; the Cleveland Fed cited tight chip and power-equipment supply from data-center demand. Data ran through Nov. 16. Futures price another hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting.

impact.zh-TW: 經濟日報引述彭博經濟研究，認為12月升息幾成定局；升息預期升溫可能壓抑高評價科技股，但報導指股市下跌已使部分升息預期降溫。12月決策尚未發生，以上為預估與推論。
impact.en: UDN cites Bloomberg Economics calling a December hike nearly certain; firmer hike bets could weigh on richly valued tech, though CNA notes recent stock declines have cooled some expectations. The December decision has not happened; estimates and inference.

title.zh-TW: 台股強彈956點收復3.9萬點，外資仍連9日賣超
title.en: Taiex rebounds 956 points to retake 39,000 as foreigners sell for 9th day

summary.zh-TW: 前一日重挫後，26日加權指數收39,151.81點，上漲956.38點、漲幅2.50%，成交約8,170億元；上漲995家、下跌87家。聯發科漲60元至3,705元，鴻海、廣達上漲，台積電則跌5元收2,145元。外資賣超約491.8億元，連9日賣超；投信、自營商與國安基金相關買盤進場。新台幣兌美元升值。
summary.en: After the prior day's slump, the Taiex closed Nov. 26 at 39,151.81, up 956.38 points or 2.50%, on about NT$817 billion turnover, with 995 gainers and 87 losers. MediaTek rose NT$60 to 3,705 and Hon Hai and Quanta gained, while TSMC slipped NT$5 to 2,145. Foreign investors net sold about NT$49.2 billion, a 9th straight day, while trusts, dealers and state funds bought.

impact.zh-TW: 反彈由內資與政策性買盤支撐，外資持續賣超，加上美股感恩節後提前收盤，短線震盪恐仍大；分析師對後市看法分歧。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: The rebound was driven by domestic and state-linked buying while foreigners kept selling; with a shortened US post-Thanksgiving session, volatility may stay high and analysts are split on the outlook. Market inference.

reason.zh-TW: 經濟日報報導點名緯創為輝達暫停東南亞出貨後可能受訂單轉移影響的台廠，可觀察美國伺服器出口管制對出貨地區與客戶結構的影響。
reason.en: UDN names Wistron among Taiwan suppliers that could see order shifts after Nvidia's reported Southeast Asia server pause; watch how US server export controls affect shipment regions and customer mix.

risk.zh-TW: 報導尚未獲輝達及品牌商證實，影響方向與規模不明；管制擴大可能延遲出貨與認列。
risk.en: The report is unconfirmed by Nvidia and brands; direction and size of impact are unclear, and wider controls could delay shipments and revenue recognition.

reason.zh-TW: 廣達為AI伺服器主要代工廠，26日隨大盤反彈上漲；輝達東南亞出貨管制與信評觀察可能影響AI伺服器需求情緒。此為產業推論，報導未直接提及廣達受影響。
reason.en: Quanta is a major AI server maker and rose in the Nov. 26 rebound; Nvidia's reported Southeast Asia pause and ratings watch may sway AI server sentiment. Industry inference; reports do not say Quanta is affected.

risk.zh-TW: AI類股波動劇烈、出口管制規則細節未明，客戶集中度高；不代表已有訂單變化。
risk.en: AI stocks are highly volatile, control rules lack detail and customer concentration is high; no order change is implied.

reason.zh-TW: 中央社報導SpaceX獲准擴大部署後，啟碁被法人列入低軌衛星台廠供應鏈，26日早盤漲停，可觀察衛星通訊題材後續發展。
reason.en: CNA reports analysts list WNC in Taiwan's LEO satellite supply chain after SpaceX's FCC approval, and it hit limit-up on Nov. 26 morning; watch how the satellite theme develops.

risk.zh-TW: 百萬顆衛星為長期執照上限，實際部署與訂單不確定；題材急漲後易劇烈回檔。
risk.en: The 1 million figure is a long-dated license cap; actual deployment and orders are uncertain, and theme-driven spikes can reverse sharply.

reason.zh-TW: 中央社報導華通名列法人點名的低軌衛星供應鏈並於26日早盤漲停，可觀察衛星板需求與AI資料中心題材連動。
reason.en: CNA reports Compeq was among analyst-cited LEO supply-chain names and hit limit-up on Nov. 26 morning; watch satellite board demand alongside the AI data-center theme.

risk.zh-TW: 供應鏈角色為法人分析而非公司確認之訂單；衛星部署時程長，評價受題材情緒影響大。
risk.en: Supply-chain roles are analyst views, not confirmed orders; deployment timelines are long and valuation is sensitive to theme sentiment.

reason.zh-TW: 台股26日大漲但台積電跌5元收2,145元；輝達為其重要客戶，標普將輝達列入負向觀察可能影響AI供應鏈情緒。輝達關聯屬產業推論。
reason.en: TSMC slipped NT$5 to 2,145 despite the Nov. 26 rally; Nvidia is a key customer, so S&P's negative watch on Nvidia may affect AI supply-chain sentiment. The Nvidia link is industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 外資連續賣超、AI評價修正與美國關稅政策均可能壓抑股價；信評觀察不代表訂單變化。
risk.en: Persistent foreign selling, AI valuation corrections and US tariff policy could weigh on shares; a ratings watch does not imply order changes.
